name: numeric-out-of-range-rejected
description: A syntactically ordinary number literal (1e400) whose value overflows the safely representable magnitude for a JSON number is refused, distinct from a literal Infinity/NaN token.
notes: Distinguished from numeric-nan-rejected/numeric-infinity-rejected: this token is an ordinary exponent-form number, not the literal NaN/Infinity text -- the defect is in evaluating its magnitude, not in tokenising it.
